skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Unfettered Freedom
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Unfettered Freedom. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, per the client's requests, twenty-four different designs of traditional women's clothing were drawn up, from which the client rolled dice to select one to ultimately be made into an outfit.
skins.quote: It bugged her how these clothes didn't fit well, so she picked a few places to make a couple of tweaks herself.

skins.name: Thunderbolt Director
skins.content: Collaborative Series/Thunderbolt Director. Clothes the prodigy director Nian wears on the job. Having analyzed countless classics, she channels the inspiration into her latest blockbuster: Unlimited Showdown in the Siege of Monster Doomsday.
skins.quote: Apparently Director Nian had a burst of inspiration. Not only has she come up with over a hundred designs for the doomsday kaiju, she is also filming a police-themed action flick with Chongyue as the lead, and shooting another movie just to help Jessica's self-esteem.
